title: Split src/storage/work.rs (23k lines) into src/storage/work/ submodules
outcome: storage/work.rs becomes a directory module whose files each own one invariant family (items and graph, runs and claims, evidence and gates, checkpoints and completion, feeds and delivery, handoffs, integrity), with tests moved beside the code they cover
acceptance: All nine gates pass; no public path outside the module changes; CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md architecture boundaries name the new directory
Every function, type, and test moves without edits other than module paths, visibility keywords needed for the split, and use statements; git diff --color-moved shows moves, not rewrites
No file under src/storage/work/ exceeds 4000 lines and the total line count changes only by module headers and use statements

completion.summary: Mechanically split the oversized local-work store into invariant-owned submodules with stable facade reexports, preserved tests and behavior, synchronized ownership docs, full gate coverage, and clean Codex/Claude closure review.
